title: Salem Saleh Babgi
description: babgi.com.sa zoominfo.com/c/salem-saleh-babgi-co-ltd/372739058 Babgi Group, founded in 1978 by Sheikh Salem Saleh Babgi, is a major Saudi Arabian conglomerate with over 1,900 employees and revenues exceeding $7.4 billion. The group operates primarily in the automotive sector (as an exclusive dealer for brands like Toyota, Lexus, and MG), trading, and contracting. Guided by a vision of sustainable economic growth, it focuses on delivering high-quality standards, advanced management practices, and community-driven services across the Kingdom
